theory.title: Unless, as long as y provided that
theory.explanation: Usa unless con el significado de «a menos que» o «si no». As long as y provided that introducen una condición que debe cumplirse para que algo ocurra. A menudo van seguidos del presente simple cuando se refieren al futuro.
theory.tip: Unless = if not. As long as / provided that = siempre que.

patterns.label: Unless, as long as y provided that · 1
patterns.pattern: You won't improve unless you practise regularly.
examples:
You won't improve unless you practise regularly.
→ No mejorarás a menos que practiques con regularidad.

patterns.label: Unless, as long as y provided that · 2
patterns.pattern: You can join the class as long as you book first.
examples:
You can join the class as long as you book first.
→ Puedes unirte a la clase siempre que reserves primero.

patterns.label: Unless, as long as y provided that · 3
patterns.pattern: Provided that you feel well, you can go for a walk.
examples:
Provided that you feel well, you can go for a walk.
→ Siempre que te encuentres bien, puedes salir a caminar.

patterns.label: Unless, as long as y provided that · 4
patterns.pattern: Unless you rest, you may feel worse.
examples:
Unless you rest, you may feel worse.
→ A menos que descanses, puede que te encuentres peor.

patterns.label: Unless, as long as y provided that · 5
patterns.pattern: You can use the gym as long as you follow the rules.
examples:
You can use the gym as long as you follow the rules.
→ Puedes utilizar el gimnasio siempre que sigas las normas.

patterns.label: Unless, as long as y provided that · 6
patterns.pattern: Provided that the doctor agrees, you can return to training.
examples:
Provided that the doctor agrees, you can return to training.
→ Siempre que el médico esté de acuerdo, podrás volver a entrenar.

patterns.label: Unless, as long as y provided that · 7
patterns.pattern: Unless we reduce screen time, our sleep may suffer.
examples:
Unless we reduce screen time, our sleep may suffer.
→ A menos que reduzcamos el tiempo de pantalla, nuestro sueño puede verse afectado.

patterns.label: Unless, as long as y provided that · 8
patterns.pattern: You can borrow the equipment as long as you return it.
examples:
You can borrow the equipment as long as you return it.
→ Puedes pedir prestado el equipo siempre que lo devuelvas.

patterns.label: Unless, as long as y provided that · 9
patterns.pattern: Provided that it doesn't rain, we'll exercise outside.
examples:
Provided that it doesn't rain, we'll exercise outside.
→ Si no llueve, haremos ejercicio al aire libre.

patterns.label: Unless, as long as y provided that · 10
patterns.pattern: You won't feel better unless you get enough rest.
examples:
You won't feel better unless you get enough rest.
→ No te encontrarás mejor a menos que descanses lo suficiente.

content.passage: The sports club has introduced a new outdoor programme. Members can join as long as they register online. Provided that the weather is suitable, the group will meet in the park twice a week. Participants won't need special equipment unless they choose the advanced session. The coach says people should not continue exercising if they feel unwell. Everyone can make progress provided that they follow the plan and rest properly.

items.prompt: Explain how someone can join a sports class as long as they register.
items.modelAnswer: I think looking after your health is about building realistic habits and making balanced choices. I try to stay active, drink enough water and get regular sleep. When I feel stressed, I take a break or go for a walk. It is important to follow medical advice and ask questions when something is unclear. Small changes can make a big difference over time, especially when people keep practising them.

content.audioTranscript: A: Have you got your appointment tomorrow? B: Yes, I want to talk about my daily routine. A: Are you doing enough exercise? B: I'm trying to. The doctor gave me some useful advice. A: What did they suggest? B: Drinking more water and getting enough sleep. A: Do you need any medicine? B: No, but I need to rest during my recovery. A: I hope you feel better by tomorrow.
